Title: True or false for JYHAD authority

Messages.Author: gcomeau@miniac.etu.gel.ulaval.ca
Messages.Body:
I got a few questions about Jyhad. True or false:



We can play action modifier cards after prey has decided not to block the
bleed (i.e. threats or bonding)


Bianca is in torpor.  Democritus wants to rescue her.  He takes the 
Encounter a vampire in torpor maneuver and pays 2 blood. Bianca still have
to take the Leave torpor maneuver before going to active region, thus she
still can be blocked and diablerized.


	Charming lobby : 
				+1 stealth
	Call a vote, if it passes, then the next vote passes automatically.
	(bold) as above and gain 2 votes


Charming lobby must be played with a political card, and if the player has
no more political cards, then his prey's political card could pass 
automatically.



Attacker declares first if he uses maneuvers, presses and declares his
strike first.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
<gcomeau@miniac.etu.gel.ulaval.ca> wrote:
>We can play action modifier cards after prey has decided not to block the
>bleed (i.e. threats or bonding)

True (section 13.3.1)

>Bianca is in torpor.  Democritus wants to rescue her.  He takes the 
>Encounter a vampire in torpor maneuver and pays 2 blood. Bianca still have
>to take the Leave torpor maneuver before going to active region, thus she
>still can be blocked and diablerized.

False.  Bianca only uses the "leave torpor" action if she needs to get
herself out.

>	Charming lobby : 
>				+1 stealth
>	Call a vote, if it passes, then the next vote passes automatically.
>	(bold) as above and gain 2 votes
>Charming lobby must be played with a political card, and if the player has
>no more political cards, then his prey's political card could pass 
>automatically.

I assume you mean you want to use Charming Lobby when you call a vote
for a Sabbat Threat (or whatever)?  This can't be done, as both using
a political to call a vote and using Charming Lobby are actions, and a
minion can't use two action cards at a same time.  Charming Lobby simply
calls for a vote which, if it passes, will cause the next vote that
turn to pass automatically.  The Lobbied vote can have no other game effect.
True that its effect is not limited to that turn, so your prey, or whoever
else, could take advantage of the Lobby.

>Attacker declares first if he uses maneuvers, presses and declares his
>strike first.  

True.

Messages.Author: Red Adept
Messages.Body:
In article <34dopt$eht@goudron.gel.ulaval.ca>,
gcomeau@miniac.etu.gel.ulaval.ca wrote:
>I got a few questions about Jyhad. True or false:

>We can play action modifier cards after prey has decided not to block the
>bleed (i.e. threats or bonding)

We've been playing that this is TRUE.


>Bianca is in torpor.  Democritus wants to rescue her.  He takes the 
>Encounter a vampire in torpor maneuver and pays 2 blood. Bianca still have
>to take the Leave torpor maneuver before going to active region, thus she
>still can be blocked and diablerized.


FALSE:  at least how we've played it.  The action of encountering a Vampire 
	in torpor can be blocked, but once you're encountering, then you just
	complete the action, you spend two blood from the minions (total) and
	move Bianca to the ready area.

>       Charming lobby : 
>                               +1 stealth
>       Call a vote, if it passes, then the next vote passes automatically.
>       (bold) as above and gain 2 votes

>Charming lobby must be played with a political card, and if the player has
>no more political cards, then his prey's political card could pass 
>automatically.


I don't have any of these cards, but as it reads above it's an action 
modifier, and can only be played when you declare an action, so yes, if you 
have no other political cards, then you're hosed.

>Attacker declares first if he uses maneuvers, presses and declares his
>strike first.  

That's how we're playing it.  The initiator, the acting minion, when blocked
goes into combat and declares all maneuvers, strikes and presses first.


--Red
